verdict.rationale: Sentry's own docs have a dedicated JavaScript 'Uploading Source Maps' page, and they describe sentry-cli as built for 'release and source maps management' and for uploading release artifacts. That covers the CLI path to un-minified production stack traces. missing for 10: any evidence of a bundler plugin (webpack/Vite/etc.), explicit CI workflow documentation, detail on how symbolicated frames appear in stack traces, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
